name: Weisgram Metal Fab
old_description: We’re ready to help with your next project. Whether you need a quote, have questions about our services or want to discuss custom fabrication, our team is here to support you. Reach out by phone, email or through our contact form, and we’ll respond as soon as we can.
about:
Weisgram Metal Fab operates from West Fargo, North Dakota, as a third-generation family-owned fabrication partner. The business was built on values of hard work, keeping commitments, and lasting relationships, though a specific founding year is not disclosed.

The company provides end-to-end metal fabrication under one roof, including laser cutting, forming, machining, welding, powder coating, and quality control. It handles projects ranging from one-off prototypes to full production runs, scaling to match customer needs. No facility size or headcount figures are published.

Weisgram serves customers across the United States and beyond, with a focus on agriculture, automotive, construction, data centers, fitness, recreation, transportation, industrial equipment, and custom equipment builders. The shop works with steel, stainless steel, and aluminum for both custom and production projects.

The firm emphasizes precision and partnership, investing in automation, advanced inspection technology (such as Virtek laser QC systems, Romer arms, and Leica laser trackers), and engineering support via AutoCAD and SolidWorks. Its quality system includes material traceability, in-process inspections, PPAP/FAI capabilities, and ISO 9001:2015 certification.
